barnase_barstar_Y29F.error_model: NO ERROR BAR — single replicate per environment; the MBAR SE of one leg is a within-leg precision estimate and understates setup variance, so it is reported separately rather than used as the uncertainty

barnase_barstar_Y29A.ref_source: SKEMPI 2.0 record for 1BRS_A_D YD29A (Kd_mut 3.5E-12 M / Kd_wt 1E-14 M at 298 K -> 3.47 kcal/mol), cited to PMID 7739054 = Schreiber & Fersht, J Mol Biol 248:478-486 (1995), 'Energetics of protein-protein interactions: analysis of the barnase-barstar interface by single mutations and double mutant cycles'

barnase_barstar_Y29F.ref_source: SKEMPI 2.0 record for 1BRS_A_D YD29F (Kd_mut 8E-15 M / Kd_wt 1E-14 M at 298 K), cited to PMID 7739054 = Schreiber & Fersht, J Mol Biol 248:478-486 (1995)

verdict.reason: all 2 benchmarks within 1.5 kcal/mol and ordering correct
verdict.gate: 5a-KS may not contribute a number to the manuscript, and the rung may not be priced from a leg rate alone, until this qualifies.

price.projection_basis: linear particle-count scaling from the benchmark's 25750 particles to 146284 (NR4A ternary leg) and ~35000 (binary leg). Linear-in-particles is the standard first-order assumption for PME MD at fixed cutoff; it is an ASSUMPTION, not a measurement, and the projected wedge cost is therefore a PROJECTION — it may not be quoted as a measured rate.
